market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 2.02% to 29,950.82 as hotter-than-expected September CPI (headline +0.6% m/m / 3.7% y/y; core +0.3% / 2.6%) lifted Fed rate-hike odds and hit richly valued AI and chip names; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slid ~4% for a sixth straight session, while defensives such as Walmart and biotech/healthcare outperformed.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-14 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.
